summary: Versatile IT professional and Full-Stack builder specializing in high-availability infrastructure, intelligent automations, and data-driven solutions. Proven track record of architecting agentic AI workflows that maximize organizational efficiency and maintaining service availability for enterprise-level environments. Passionate about bridging the gap between robust DevOps practices and advanced AI/Data Science engineering to deploy scalable, resilient, and intelligent systems. Eager to leverage a strong technical foundation and an entrepreneurial mindset to drive impactful digital transformation in DevOps, AI, or Data Science roles.
